**Compliance Answer: Incomplete customer records must be addressed immediately to ensure full compliance with the FIC Act, as institutions are required to maintain comprehensive client due diligence and transaction records throughout their business relationship.**  

**Relevant Regulatory Basis: Section 22 of the Financial Intelligence Centre Act (FIC Act) provides for an obligation on accountable institutions to keep customer due dilig0165, which includes maintaining comprehensive client due diligence and transaction records throughout their business relationship.**  

**Explanation: Accountable financial institutions are required by the FIC Act to retain all information obtained from clients for verification of identity as per sections 21-21H. This obligation extends to keeping detailed records of transactions, which must be maintained in accordance with section 22A of the act throughout the duration of any business relationship established under its provisions.**
